en: Vintage monochrome postcard with two circular photographs of ancient sculpted heads. The left shows a male (or youth) marble head labeled as being from the Acropolis, and the right shows a female head labeled as being from Candia (Crete). Above them is the title in Greek and French indicating Athens. There is a central circular postal cancellation dated 1902 and Greek and French captions printed below each image, along with a small printed note about the Hellenic postal service at the bottom.
